scientific_integrity: The proof explicitly classifies every reduction stratum and all dual-number lift nullities in odd characteristic. Finite checks corroborate but do not establish the theorem. Only labeled ordered pairs are counted; not simultaneous-conjugacy orbits. The characteristic-two boundary is excluded because existing exterior-algebra deformation work already covers that case. No independent validation is asserted.

Absolute absence of earlier equivalent literature not established
title: Commuting square-zero pairs over finite dual numbers in dimension three: an exact odd-characteristic count
